verdict.rationale: Simular's own marketing says Sai can be taught a workflow once and then 'reruns on a schedule' (simular-docs-14). Supporting context: workflows can be saved as code and replayed (simular-docs-7), and Sai runs in a persistent cloud VM that keeps working with your laptop closed (simular-docs-23, simular-docs-16). Scheduling itself rests on a single marketing line with no documentation of how schedules are set up. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron or interval syntax, time zones), any API or SDK endpoint for creating or managing schedules, schedule management UI docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation that recurring runs work.
